رَجُلٌ حَمِيزُ الفُؤَادِ , and ↓ حَامِزُهُ , (assumed tropical:) A strong-hearted man: (S, TA:) or a man who is active, sharp or quick in intellect, clever, ingenious, or acute in mind, (K, TA,) and strong-hearted. (TA.) ―
-b2- And ↓ the latter, (assumed tropical:) A man contrasted in heart. (TA.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
